meta.title: Suggest a Smoking Area or No-Smoking Zone
meta.description: Pick a spot on the map to request that a new smoking area or no-smoking zone be added.

header.title: Suggest a new area
header.description: Mark a smoking area or no-smoking zone on the map to suggest it

guide.draw: Select “Draw area”, then place at least 3 points on the map to mark the area.
guide.publish: Areas you suggest are posted on the board. Once an area gets 20 or more “Correct” votes, an administrator reviews it and adds it to the map.

location.title: Location
location.pinMode: Select a spot on the map to fill in the location automatically
location.geocodeFailed: Couldn’t find an address for this spot. Enter the address yourself.

area.title: Area
area.samePoint: There’s already a point here. Move the map, then add the next point.
area.needMore: Place at least 3 points ({remaining} more needed)

privacyNotice: When you submit a request, the information you entered, such as the area’s location, address, building name and type, is sent and posted publicly on the board. For details, see our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
submitFailed: Couldn’t submit the area. Try again later.

success.title: Request submitted!
success.description: The area you suggested will be posted on the board. Once it gets 20 or more “Correct” votes, an administrator reviews it and adds it to the map.

map.label: Map for choosing a location
map.drawingHint: Place points on the map to mark the area
map.pinHint: Select a spot on the map to fill in the address automatically
